title: KnowledgeBaseMetadata
description: Build-only metadata kept separate from index.json so the runtime index stays small. Consumed by the preprocessing pipeline but never loaded by dt-app-mcp.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this file was generated by the pipeline.

SourceEntry.description: Build-time record for a single source document.

url.description: Original download URL of the source document.

downloadHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the raw downloaded file, used to detect upstream changes.

downloadedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this source was last downloaded.

chunkPaths.description: Paths of all chunks produced from this source (matches ChunkEntry.path values in index.json).
